observations: Photo 0 shows a white Xbox One console with two controllers: one white and one blue/white (both with Xbox button layout).
Photo 1 shows the side/front of the console with visible ports and the Xbox logo on the right side; controllers are resting on top.
Photo 2 shows the console top/vent area and both controllers side-by-side; no cables, box, or storage details are visible.

read_from: photo 0 (Xbox controller button layout and console design consistent with Xbox One)
photo 1 (console form factor and Xbox logo)

claims.claim: Neatly UK Used Xbox One available with 2 pad
claims.evidence: Photos show an Xbox One console and two controllers (photo 0 and photo 2). UK origin is not verifiable from photos.
Photos show cosmetic condition but no power-on test, no screen/drive/audio/video checks (photo 0/1/2).

claims.claim: Comes with Fc26 Package and other...
claims.evidence: No visible FC26 package contents, accessories, or documentation in the photos (photo 0/1/2).

risks.risk: Console may not power on properly, may overheat, or may have faulty ports/drive (common for used consoles).
risks.proof: A short video of power-on to the Xbox dashboard + showing disc drive reading (if disc model) or storage detection.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not fully verified/possible faults until tested.

risks.risk: Controllers may have drift, dead buttons, or poor charging/connection.
risks.proof: Video showing both controllers connected and working in a game/menu + quick joystick movement test (no drift) and button test.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as controllers may be imperfect (worst case: one or both may need repair).

risks.risk: Storage size/model variant (Xbox One vs One S/One X) and whether it’s HDD/SSD affects value.
risks.proof: Photo of the console model label/serial sticker and a screenshot of System > Storage.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest likely variant/value for an Xbox One without confirmed storage details.

risks.risk: Missing essential accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, controller charging cable/battery type) or incomplete bundle.
risks.proof: Photo laid out showing every included item with cables clearly visible (power brick/cable, HDMI, controller charging method).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as bundle may be incomplete (worst case: buyer must source missing cables/accessories).

risks.risk: “UK used” and “FC26 package” may be misleading; region lock or account/banned status could affect usability.
risks.proof: Screenshot of console region settings and a sign-in attempt showing no ban/lock; also show offline dashboard access.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as standard used console with no guarantee on account/region/package claims.

proof_requests: Power-on video to the Xbox dashboard (and show both controllers working).
Screenshot/photo of System > Storage (and model label/serial sticker).
Video or photo showing disc drive reading (if applicable) or confirming installed games/storage.
Clear photos of all included accessories/cables and what exactly is in the “FC26 package”.
response.reason: The photos confirm an Xbox One console with two controllers, but key value drivers (exact variant/storage, full functionality, included accessories, and what “FC26 package” contains) are not verifiable remotely. To price safely for Lagos pickup, we need power-on and storage/model label proof.
